summary: A conversation page from a native transcript stays under 768 KiB: a seat with very large entries gets a shorter newest page and a cursor for the rest, so its conversation can still be read through another host, whose reads of a remote owner are capped at 1 MiB

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: No schema, operation or contract digest change. A page may hold fewer entries than its limit; has_more and next_cursor already say there is more.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change.

compatibility.detail: Older clients already follow has_more and next_cursor; the page's limit is a maximum, not a promise.

downtime.detail: No downtime. The fix takes effect on a member once it is deployed there; the owner of the seat builds the page, so the owner must run it.

recovery.detail: No recovery, durable payload or initialization changes.
